text: hm. it seems that all my models are gone now lol. D: haha [Image #4]
resolution: Models showed empty in the Studio after the import/restart. Root cause: the model store is an append-only SQLite event log whose fast-boot SNAPSHOT cache got corrupted — high-detail imports wrote entire meshes as single events (one 33MB event) plus 3307 paint-bake events (351MB), bloating the log to 575MB; on dev-host restart the boot rebuilds the snapshot by loading the WHOLE log at once and OOM'd (the known req_1556 failure mode), writing a degraded 1-model snapshot. The event log itself (source of truth) was intact. Recovered all 96 models by streaming the log through a faithful Python port of modelStream.apply (the v8cli SQL binding couldn't return the 544MB result set), PROVEN correct by full byte-for-byte deep-equality against the _compact_backup snapshot at seq 15613 (59 models). Backed everything up first (_MODEL_RECOVERY_BACKUP_20260629/, 631MB), exported all 96 models as individual self-contained files (recovered-models/), and installed a clean 92-model snapshot to the live store (the 4 oversized broken imports new_mesh_045-048 kept as files only). Verified: live snapshot loads 92 models with a matching seam (events=21298).
